_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 112 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: GPDIS

description.text: Once set on the ground, the Grenade Intercept System tracks and destroys incoming projectiles such as hand-thrown and launched grenades. Can intercept up to three projectiles during a window of activation that begins after the initial detection.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
